remarks:
A peaceful setting surrounded by wildlife. 
Located in Findley Lake, this 15.6 acres track of wooded land offers the potential to build the weekend getaway, forever country home, or hunting cabin of your dreams. Enjoy privacy and room to explore nature while still being conveniently close to nearby services and recreation. 
The charming town of Findley Lake offers boating, fishing, swimming, and dining while a nearby 4 season resort offers golfing, winter skiing and so much more for a family to enjoy. Access to the Chautauqua County snow mobile trail is approximately 300 yards away. Easy access off NYS I-86 makes this property the perfect combination of nature, recreation, and accessibility all in one exceptional package.
